reading_note: The arc: hereditary self-love (Sin) has bound the spiritual life (soul) within five degrees of the natural man (bone, sinew, vein, flesh, skin), pressing each of the five faculties of reception (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection) into bondage to natural appetite. The operative divine truth (Living Spirit / Mind of Light) descends, releases each faculty of the soul from its corresponding member, and binds the answering faculty of self-love in its place, replacing each evil affection with its heavenly correspondent — love in the mind, faith in the thought, patience in the counsel, wisdom in the reflection — and so forms the New Man, the regenerate. The teaching closes by showing the alternation: self-love still rises and stirs turmoil from time to time, but the Mind of Light reigns; like the great gods who stand outside the Zone unmanifest, the divine truth has contracted itself into the small body of man, hidden within the watch-posts, yet sovereign over the heart.
